info.title: Transmute API
info.description:
API to interact with Transmute without the need for a frontend.

## Authentication

### Getting an API key

Authenticate with your user account first, then create a key under 'My Account' -> 'API Keys'.
The generated key is shown exactly once, so store it safely after creation.

### Using an API key

For any endpoint that expects bearer authentication, send your API key in the `Authorization` header:

```http
Authorization: Bearer <your-api-key>
```

The API accepts either a JWT bearer token for authenticated users through the web interface,
or an API key for programmatic access anywhere bearer auth is required.

get.summary: List conversion jobs for the current user
get.description:
List the current user's conversion jobs, newest-first.

Optional ``status_filter`` query parameter narrows the result to one of:
``queued``, ``running``, ``completed``, ``failed``, ``cancelled``.

post.description: Validate the request and enqueue a new conversion job.

get.description: Get one of the current user's jobs by ID.

delete.description:
Delete a job that has reached a terminal state.

Only ``failed`` and ``cancelled`` jobs may be removed via this endpoint.
Completed jobs are represented in the conversions list and removed via
``DELETE /api/conversions/{id}``; queued/running jobs must be cancelled
first.

post.description:
Cancel a job that has not yet started running.

Only ``queued -> cancelled`` is supported in this version. Cancelling a
running job is intentionally deferred; callers must wait for it to
complete or fail.

post.summary: Retry a failed or cancelled conversion job
post.description:
Re-queue a job that previously ended in ``failed`` or ``cancelled``.

The source file must still exist and be owned by the caller — if the
original was deleted (e.g. ``keep_originals=false``) the retry is rejected
with a 404 so the user can re-upload before trying again.

404.description: Job or source file not found

409.description: Job is not in a retryable state

get.description: Return all user-configured default compression-level mappings.

put.description: Create or update a default compression level for a given media format.

delete.description: Remove a default compression-level mapping for the given media format.

get.description:
Return the current user's application settings.

Cleanup settings are always sourced from the first admin's row,
since they are a system-wide concern managed by administrators.

patch.description:
Partially update the current user's settings. Only provided fields are changed.

Cleanup settings (cleanup_enabled, cleanup_ttl_minutes) are admin-only.

get.description:
Return every custom theme registered in the database.

Available to any authenticated user so the frontend can render the
theme picker. The built-in keys are returned alongside so the client
knows which entries are statically defined in CSS.

200.description: All custom themes plus the built-in theme keys

post.description: Admin-only endpoint to register a new theme available to every user.

put.description: Admin-only endpoint that replaces the display name and/or color tokens of an existing theme.

delete.description: Admin-only endpoint. Any user currently selecting this theme is reset to `rubedo`.

get.description: Return all user-configured default format mappings.

put.description: Create or update a default output format for a given input format.

delete.description: Remove a default format mapping for the given input format.

get.description: Return all user-configured default quality mappings.

put.description: Create or update a default quality for a given output format.

delete.description: Remove a default quality mapping for the given output format.

get.description: Return whether the application still needs its first admin account.

200.description: Whether first-time user setup is required

get.description: Return all users without exposing password hashes.

post.description: Create a new user and hash the provided password before storage.
Issue a JWT bearer token using the OAuth2 password flow form.
Validate username and password and issue a JWT bearer token.

get.description: Return the authenticated user derived from the bearer token.

patch.description: Allow a user to update their own account except for role changes.

get.description: Return a user by UUID without exposing the password hash.

patch.description: Partially update a user, hashing a replacement password when provided.

delete.description: Delete a user by UUID and cascade-remove all their data.

get.summary: List API keys for the current user
get.description: Return all API keys belonging to the authenticated user (without hashes).

post.description:
Generate a new API key for the authenticated user.

The raw key is returned exactly once in this response and is never stored.

201.description: API key created (raw key shown once)

delete.description: Delete one of the authenticated user's API keys.

get.summary: Get OIDC configuration for the frontend
get.description: Return whether OIDC is available and its display name (no secrets).
Redirect the user to the OIDC provider's authorization endpoint.
Handle the OIDC provider callback, link or create a user, and redirect with a session token.

post.summary: Exchange a one-time OIDC code for a JWT
post.description: Trade the short-lived code from the callback redirect for the real JWT.

post.summary: Create or resume a guest session
post.description: Create a new guest user or resume an existing guest session via cookie.

get.description: Return upload, output-file, and storage stats for every user (admin only).
